page.subtitle: What renters see on the marketplace, plus the internal details XePrime uses to review your shop.

forbidden.title: You don't have access
forbidden.description: You need the permission below to view the shop profile.

noTenant.title: You don't have a shop yet
noTenant.description: You can still use this account to search for and book vehicles. You only need a shop if you want to rent your vehicles out.

status.incomplete: {count, plural, one {# item still needs attention} other {# items still need attention}} — we moved the cursor to the first one.

submitConfirm.title: Submit this profile for review?
submitConfirm.description: Once submitted, you cannot edit the profile until we get back to you.
submitConfirm.descriptionWithSave: Your unsaved changes will be saved first, then submitted. Once submitted, you cannot edit the profile until we get back to you.

draft.title: This profile has not been submitted yet
draft.body: Fill in the required items below, then press Submit for review. Your vehicles only go public once the profile is approved.
draft.shell: Your vehicles are not on the marketplace yet. Complete your profile and submit it for review to start taking bookings.

pending.title: Your profile is waiting for review
pending.body: While you wait, you can already add vehicles and get your data ready.
pending.shell: XePrime is reviewing your profile. Your vehicles go live as soon as it is approved.

needsRevision.title: We need more information
needsRevision.body: Update what was asked for, then press Resubmit for review.
needsRevision.shell: XePrime needs more information from you before your shop can be approved.

rejected.title: Profile rejected
rejected.body: Fix what the reason below mentions and send it again — you can still resubmit.
rejected.shell: Your shop profile was not approved. Read the reason, fix it and submit again.

active.title: Your shop is live
active.body: Your approved vehicles are showing on the marketplace.

suspended.title: Your shop is locked
suspended.body: Your vehicles are hidden from the marketplace and cannot take new bookings. Contact the XePrime team for details.
suspended.shell: Your shop is locked: vehicles are hidden from the marketplace and cannot take new bookings.

expired.title: Your plan has expired
expired.body: Renew your plan to put your vehicles back on the marketplace.
expired.shell: Your plan has expired, so your vehicles are hidden from the marketplace.

form.lockedWhilePending: Editing is locked while the profile is under review.
form.readOnly: You have view-only access to the shop profile.

displayName.label: Display name
displayName.placeholder: The name shown on the marketplace

bio.label: About the shop
bio.placeholder: A short description of your shop…

privacy.title: Kept private
privacy.body: Owner details are visible only to the XePrime team and are never shown to renters.

province.label: Province / City
province.loadError: Couldn't load the list of provinces
province.help: Where your default branch sits — vehicles at that branch are listed in this province.

bank.title: Payout account
bank.hint: XePrime uses this account to reconcile and pay out to your shop.

checklist.title: Complete your profile
checklist.suggestedTitle: Recommended — helps renters pick your shop

items.province: Province the shop is based in

validation.ownerFullNameRequired: Shop owner's full name is required
validation.ownerPhoneRequired: Shop owner's phone number is required

policies.title: Default rental policy
policies.subtitle: Set the rules and charges applied by default to every booking.
policies.overridden: {count, plural, other {# vehicle(s)}} use their own policy and do not inherit this default.
policies.loadError: Could not load the rental policy

forbidden.title: No access
forbidden.description: You need the permission below to view your shop rental policy.

policies.emptyBody: Without a policy, new bookings take no deposit, offer no delivery and carry no long-term discount. Fill in the settings below, then save the policy.
policies.readOnly: You can only view the shop rental policy.
policies.depositHint: {count, plural, other {# vehicle(s)}} use this deposit

confirm.title: Apply the new rental policy?
confirm.body: The new policy applies to new bookings. Bookings already confirmed keep their original price and deposit.
confirm.bodyInheriting: The new policy applies immediately to {count, plural, other {# vehicle(s)}} inheriting it, starting from new bookings. Bookings already confirmed keep their original price and deposit.

paymentSettings.title: Deposit collection
paymentSettings.subtitle: Decide whether XePrime holds the customer deposit before the trip. This is not the same as the security deposit you take at the counter — that one lives in Rental policies.

forbidden.title: Access denied
forbidden.description: You need the permission below to view this shop deposit settings.

toggle.label: Let XePrime collect the deposit for me

mode.onTitle: Customers pay the deposit before the booking exists
mode.onBody: The customer scans a VietQR code and transfers the deposit to XePrime within 2 hours of your approval. The booking is only created once the money arrives, so no slot is held by a request that never materialises. The customer pays you the rest of the rent directly at pickup.
mode.offTitle: You arrange the deposit with the customer yourself
mode.offBody: Approving creates the booking straight away, with no wait for money. You contact the customer to arrange the deposit directly — XePrime neither collects nor reconciles it, so if a dispute over the deposit arises XePrime has no record to support you.

commission.title: Your shop always collects deposits through XePrime
commission.body: You are on the commission track: no subscription fee, and XePrime charges a per-trip service fee on the customer side. The deposit is a condition of this track, so the switch is locked. Move to a subscription plan if you want to decide for yourself.

featureMissing.title: Your current plan does not include this
featureMissing.body: Deposit collection through XePrime is part of the subscription plan. Until then you still take bookings as usual and arrange deposits with customers directly.

notConfigured.title: We cannot determine your shop plan
notConfigured.body: We could not read an active service plan for your shop, so fees cannot be calculated and new bookings are paused. This is a XePrime configuration problem, not something you did. Contact support to get it fixed.

paymentSettings.frozen: Changing this switch only affects rental requests approved from now on. Existing bookings keep the deposit arrangement frozen when they were created.

unverified.title: Shop not verified yet
unverified.body: Your vehicles still list and go live as usual — verification is only needed when you want to buy a shop plan and unlock the full management suite.

pending.title: Waiting for XePrime to verify your profile
pending.body: Nothing changes for your vehicles: approved ones stay on the marketplace and keep taking bookings.

needsRevision.title: XePrime needs more details
needsRevision.body: Update what was asked for and submit again. Your vehicles keep running in the meantime.

rejected.title: Verification declined
rejected.body: Fix the points below and submit again. This does not affect the vehicles you already have listed.

verified.title: Shop verified
verified.body: You can now buy a shop plan to unlock the ledger, receivables, staff and reports.
